expectations.text: Recommended angles skew to B2B arguments (quantified outcome, risk or compliance reduction, peer proof, total cost of ownership) for a reader building an internal case.
expectations.evidence: The answer never recommends messaging angles at all — no peer proof, TCO, compliance/risk-reduction, or quantified-outcome creative angles are proposed. It only references the two angles already in play ('cost-savings ad', 'driver-safety' segment) as existing assets, and prescribes 'a different headline or CTA, same cost-savings angle' without specifying any angle content. The only quantified B2B-style argumentation appears in the 'What to tell your CMO' script (18 demos/month, 1.5 per variant, $14k sales-led product), which serves an internal case for test design rather than ad angles.
